title: Injin bayanai da dabarar da ke bayan kowane dashboard

say: Injin bayanai da dabarar da ke bayan kowane dashboard.
Wannan shine bidiyon don module ɗaya na Advanced Excel da Dashboards.
A matakin ci gaba, ɓangaren wuya na Excel ba shi da ƙima. Siffar bayanan ce. Yawancin littattafan aiki suna da kyau akan allo amma an gina su kamar littafin rubutu.

say: SUMIFS yana sanya abin da za a tara a farko, sai kuma nau'i-nau'i na inda za a duba da abin da za a nema. Tsohuwar SUMIF tana sanya jimlar kewayon ƙarshe. Haɗa su babban kuskure ne.
Tola yana adana kwanakin, samfuri da gari a cikin sel, don haka tsari ɗaya zai iya amsa tambayoyi da yawa. Ba ta taɓa rubuta kwanan wata a cikin maganganun ba.

card.title: SUMIFS: Layer mash a Oyo, a cikin Maris

say: Don gwada shi, ta tace Table da hannu. Layuka biyar sun rage: 174,000, 290,000, 145,000, 87,000 da 232,000.

say: Suna ƙara har zuwa 928,000. Tantanin halitta SUMIFS yana nuna 928,000, don haka dabarar ta yi daidai. Canza tantanin halitta kuma amsa yana ɗaukaka nan take.

say: VLOOKUP ba tare da gardamarsa ta ƙarshe tana amfani da kusan wasa ba. A jerin da ba a rarraba ba zai iya dawo da farashi mara kyau ba tare da kuskure ba kwata-kwata. Koyaushe ƙare shi da KARYA.

panel.heading: VLOOKUP da XLOOKUP
left: Yana karya lokacin da aka saka ginshiƙai

say: XLOOKUP ya fi aminci, kuma yanayin wasansa ya rage 1 yana ɗaukar matakan hawa. Wakilin da ke da Naira 760,000 na tallace-tallace yana samun matakin 500,000 a kashi 3, don haka Naira 22,800 ya biya.
XLOOKUP yana buƙatar Excel 2021, 2024 ko Microsoft 365. Don 2016 ko 2019, yi amfani da INDEX tare da MATCH.

panel.heading: VLOOKUP da XLOOKUP
